content: {"praised":["Great production value and visual quality.","Strong performances by Viggo Mortensen and Keira Knightley.","Accurate historical tone and content.","Nuanced, mature directorial style.","Thoughtful exploration of sexual repression and desire."],"criticized":["Story lacks depth and dramatic tension.","Poor casting choice for Russian character.","Interplay between Freud and Jung underdeveloped.","Film feels too complex for general audience.","Overall pacing feels slow and unengaging."]}
